model.name: Qwen Image 2.1 Turbo 7B
model.description: Official Qwen-Image-2.1-Turbo checkpoint for image generation and editing with up to 10 reference images. Uses its published 8-step schedule at CFG 1; no acceleration LoRA is needed. Shares the Qwen Image 2.1 text encoder, processor and VAE. BF16 and INT8 ConvRot download on demand. Qwen Research License: non-commercial research/evaluation only; commercial use requires a separate license from Qwen.
